title: Index Funds Now Control 52% Of The Market
hook: Index funds now control 52% of the market.
closing: Passive investing still concentrates voting power in firms deciding how your shares speak.
question: Who should vote your shares?

segments.say: Index funds reached 52% of the market, turning passive investing into the dominant ownership force.
The three biggest managers hold 22% of a typical large company, concentrating corporate influence.
Vanguard alone casts 9% of major-company votes, giving one manager enormous influence over boardrooms.
